hints: Apply Newton's second law along the slope in the uphill direction: $F_D - mg\sin 4^\circ - R = ma$.
Notice the train is decelerating at $0.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$, so the acceleration in the forward direction is $a = -0.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$.
Calculate the forward driving force $F_D$ using $m = 240000\text{ kg}$, $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$, and $R = 18000\text{ N}$.
Use the power formula $P = F_D \times v$ with $v = 15\text{ m s}^{-1}$ to find the engine power.
walkthrough:
Apply Newton's second law, $F_{\text{net}} = ma$, parallel to the slope in the uphill direction, noting that a deceleration of $0.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$ means $a = -0.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$:
$$F_D - mg\sin 4^\circ - R = ma$$
$$F_D - 240000(10)\sin 4^\circ - 18000 = 240000(-0.2)$$

Compute the numerical values for the opposing forces and mass times acceleration:
$$mg\sin 4^\circ = 2400000\sin 4^\circ \approx 2400000(0.069756) \approx 167415.5\text{ N}$$
$$ma = 240000(-0.2) = -48000\text{ N}$$
$$F_D - 167415.5 - 18000 = -48000$$
$$F_D - 185415.5 = -48000 \implies F_D = 185415.5 - 48000 \approx 137415.5\text{ N}$$

Use the relationship between power, driving force, and velocity $P = F_D \times v$ at speed $v = 15\text{ m s}^{-1}$:
$$P = 137415.5 \times 15 \approx 2061233\text{ W} \approx 2060000\text{ W} \quad (2060\text{ kW})$$
teacher_walkthrough:
State Newton's second law for motion along an inclined plane:
$$F_{\text{net}} = ma$$
Taking the uphill direction as positive, the net force on the train is the forward driving force $F_D$ minus the resistance $R$ and minus the component of gravity down the slope:
$$F_D - mg\sin 4^\circ - R = ma$$
Because the problem specifies a deceleration of $0.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$, the forward acceleration is negative:
$$a = -0.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$$

Substitute the known values ($m = 240000\text{ kg}$, $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$, $R = 18000\text{ N}$):
$$F_D - 240000 \times 10 \times \sin 4^\circ - 18000 = 240000 \times (-0.2)$$
$$F_D - 2400000\sin 4^\circ - 18000 = -48000$$

Evaluate each term:
$$\sin 4^\circ \approx 0.0697565$$
$$2400000 \times 0.0697565 = 167415.5\text{ N}$$
Combine the constant resisting terms on the left:
$$F_D - 167415.5 - 18000 = -48000$$
$$F_D - 185415.5 = -48000$$
Add $185415.5$ to both sides:
$$F_D = 185415.5 - 48000 = 137415.5\text{ N}$$

State the formula for mechanical power in terms of driving force and speed:
$$P = F_D \times v$$
Substitute $F_D = 137415.5\text{ N}$ and $v = 15\text{ m s}^{-1}$:
$$P = 137415.5 \times 15 = 2061232.5\text{ W}$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives:
$$P = 2060000\text{ W} = 2060\text{ kW} = 2.06\text{ MW}$$
